preconditions.expression: all(len(line.strip()) == 1 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()) and all(len(S) >= 1 and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S) for S in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]])
preconditions.description: The first line of stdin is an integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 10^4), and each subsequent line is a non-empty string S of lowercase English letters (1 ≤ |S| ≤ 10^6).

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout_line.strip()) == 1 and (int(stdout_line.strip()) == -1 or (int(stdout_line.strip()) >= 1 and int(stdout_line.strip()) <= len(S))) for S, stdout_line in zip([line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]], stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: For each string S, the output is either -1 (no valid P exists) or an integer L (1 ≤ L ≤ |S|) representing the maximum length of a non-empty substring P of S such that no non-empty substring of P is a prefix or suffix of S.

postconditions.expression: all((int(stdout_line.strip()) == -1) == (not any(len(P) >= 1 and P in S and not any(P[:i] in S[:i] for i in range(1, len(P)+1)) and not any(P[-i:] in S[-i:] for i in range(1, len(P)+1)) for P in [S[j:k] for j in range(len(S)) for k in range(j+1, len(S)+1)])) for S, stdout_line in zip([line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]], stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: If a valid P exists, the output is the maximum length of such a P; otherwise, it is -1. A valid P is a non-empty substring of S where no non-empty substring of P is a prefix or suffix of S.
